// Host tempo (FFGL SetBeatInfo): iBPM, iBeat (beats elapsed), iBarPhase (0..1 per bar).
// Left half: brightness ramps up over each bar. Right half: flashes on every beat.
// Without host tempo (preview, ISF hosts) it runs at 120 BPM / the BPM slider.
void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = fragCoord / iResolution.xy;
    float v = uv.x < 0.5 ? iBarPhase : 1.0 - fract(iBeat);
    fragColor = vec4(vec3(v) * vec3(0.2, 0.8, 1.0) * (iBPM / 120.0), 1.0);
}
